clips.title: The story
paras: In Astranaar, Shindrell Swiftfire writes a missive about corruption near the town and along Ashenvale's coast. She sends the intelligence report east through the forest to Kayneth Stillwind.

Sentinels and druids coordinate to watch Ashenvale's borders as unrest spreads through the forest. In Astranaar, Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire writes of troubling disturbances along the western coast and among the central canopies. She addresses her report to Kayneth Stillwind, a druid at the shrine of Forest Song in the Nightsong Woods to the east. Couriers carry Shindrell's firsthand observations to aid Kayneth's investigation of corruption creeping through the sacred groves.
